title: CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of information extraction from legal contracts. While the motivation for the work includes improving access to legal support and mitigating consumer harm (an ethical consideration), the paper's core contribution and evaluation methodology do not involve benchmarking or assessing models on their understanding of ethics, morals, or faith. The task is to identify specific legal clauses, not to make ethical judgments about them.
